data.long_description:
Experience refined community living in this spacious 4-bedroom independent villa located in the highly sought-after Fairway Villas community in Emaar South. Set on an expansive plot of 6,520 sq. ft. with a built-up area of 3,126 sq. ft., this home offers the perfect balance of space, privacy, and modern comfort.

The villa features a thoughtfully designed layout with bright, open living and dining areas, generously sized bedrooms, and large windows that invite natural light throughout the home. The expansive plot provides ample outdoor space—ideal for entertaining, family gatherings, or simply enjoying peaceful surroundings.

Nestled within a serene golf course community, residents benefit from a tranquil lifestyle while still being well-connected to key areas of Dubai.

Property Features:
• 4 Spacious Bedrooms
• Independent Villa
• Built-Up Area: 3,126 sq. ft.
• Plot Size: 6,520 sq. ft.
• Bright and Open Living Spaces
• Large Private Garden
• Covered Parking

Community Highlights:
• Gated Golf Course Community
• Parks & Green Spaces
• Family-Friendly Environment
• Easy Access to Major Road Networks

Rental Price: AED 360,000 per year
